title: Quote a fare for a caller
caption: shopping/actions.ts. amadeus:read (owner, admin, agent). Read-only, net prices, every call sent once (maxRetries 0), each an audited amadeus.<operation> staff action.

steps.title: Open shopping
steps.body: Read the notices above the tabs.
steps.expect: Environment and offices named; "net prices"; the default markup rule in words; "booking on behalf comes later".

steps.title: Search offers
steps.body: From, to, departure (and return), 2 adults + 1 infant on lap, cabin, **Search offers**.
steps.expect: Offers with flights in local times, fare, bags, seats, last ticketing day and the **net total**; the verbatim answer in a collapsed JSON view.

steps.title: Branded fares and price
steps.body: On an offer: **Branded fares**, then **Confirm price** (optionally with the detailed fare rules).
steps.expect: Each fare with its net total; the confirmed net price (both when it changed), booking requirements, bag options.

steps.title: Seat availability
steps.body: Availability tab: from, to, day, seats; **Search availability**.
steps.expect: Seats per booking class (`J2 Y9 BL`) with the legend.

steps.title: Edge cases
steps.body: 2 infants for 1 adult; destination `ZZZ`; the stub's timeout scenario.
steps.expect: Field error before any call; "no offers"; "Amadeus did not answer… Search again" with exactly one `supplier_requests` row.
